title: Breezy Ligne-Claire
description: Un style d'illustration ludique aux couleurs plates, caractérisé par des contours noirs distincts et légèrement irréguliers, ainsi que des remplissages sans ombrage. L'esthétique s'inspire des traditions de la bande dessinée à ligne claire, mais injecte une touche décontractée et tremblotante dans le tracé.
description_en: A playful, flat-color illustration style characterized by distinct, slightly irregular black outlines and unshaded color fills. The aesthetic draws from clear-line comic traditions but injects a casual, hand-drawn wobble into the linework.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration ludique aux couleurs plates, caractérisé par des contours noirs distincts et légèrement irréguliers, ainsi que des remplissages sans ombrage. L'esthétique s'inspire des traditions de la bande dessinée à ligne claire, mais injecte une touche décontractée et tremblotante dans le tracé.
prompt: Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Render the scene as a digital 2D illustration in a casual ligne-claire comic style. The defining feature is the linework: use solid, slightly wobbly, and irregular black outlines that look hand-drawn with a slightly textured ink pen. Do not use perfectly smooth or geometric vector lines. Fill enclosed areas with completely flat, unshaded blocks of color using {{primary_color}}, {{accent_color}}, and {{secondary_color}}. There must be absolutely no gradients, no soft shading, no highlights, and no ambient occlusion. The lighting is completely flat and non-directional, relying entirely on the black linework to define forms, overlapping shapes, and depth. Edges should be crisp where color meets the black outline. Include minimal, loose, floating line details to suggest texture (like small arcs or dashes for ground or surface details). The atmosphere should be bright, cheerful, and playfully naive. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners.

video.motion: Characters and objects should move with a slight boil or jitter to match the wobbly linework, using stepped keyframes (e.g., 12fps) for a hand-drawn animation feel.
video.camera: Static or slow, flat 2D panning; avoid 3D camera moves or perspective distortion.
video.temporal_texture: The wobbly black outlines must exhibit a continuous 'line boil' effect, while the flat color fills remain perfectly stable and unshaded.
video.avoid: Smooth 60fps interpolation, 3D depth, shading, gradients, motion blur, and perfectly rigid vector lines.
